summary: URLSession-style HTTP(S) with redirects, download and a memory cache exists, and GCD and ProcessInfo have SDK counterparts. Bonjour, XPC, streams/sockets/ports and Process/NSTask have no app-facing API.

features.feature: URL Loading: sessions, requests, data and download tasks
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/url.rs; springboard/sdk/tests/url.rs; docs/bifrost-ui.md (URLSession section); springboard/sdk/src/url_background.rs (URLSessionConfiguration, ConfiguredSession, BackgroundSession, URLSessionTaskMetrics); springboard/sdk/tests/url_session.rs
features.note: shared session, data_task, download_task with progress, upload_task and upload_task_from_file, streaming bytes, redirects up to 5; default/ephemeral/background configurations, task delegate challenges, task metrics, persisted background download queue. Upload tasks (from data and from file, streamed, with didSendBodyData progress and byte counts) come from the integration side. No OS-level background transfer. Host tests only; verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (URLCache); wired: springboard/apps/news-desktop/src/feed_cache.rs (plan, stored_from, max_age_of, validators_of, Conditional); springboard/sdk/src/url_cache.rs (disk URLCache, CachedURLResponse, CachePolicy)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests (earlier part). Added later, host tests only: memory cache plus a disk URLCache with memory/disk capacity, Cache-Control/ETag/304 revalidation, oldest-first eviction and per-request CachePolicy, wired into ConfiguredSession. Host tests only; verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: URL Loading: cookies, credentials, authentication challenges
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/http_auth.rs; springboard/sdk/src/http_digest.rs (parse_digest_challenge, authorization); springboard/sdk/src/http_cookies.rs; springboard/sdk/src/url_background.rs (ConfiguredSession wires jar, credential storage and delegate)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests (earlier part). Host tests only: cookie jar (accept policy Always/Never) and credential storage are used by ConfiguredSession; a 401 Basic challenge goes to the delegate and is retried once. The Digest (MD5, qop auth) challenge is parsed and answered headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-41.rs, including the RFC 2617 worked example, and ConfiguredSession now answers a 401 Digest challenge once (nc=00000001, fresh client nonce) from the stored or delegate credential; tests in springboard/sdk/src/url_background.rs: a_digest_challenge_is_answered_with_the_matching_response_digest, a_digest_challenge_without_a_credential_returns_the_401_after_one_request, a_second_digest_401_stops_after_two_requests, an_unparsable_or_unsupported_digest_challenge_is_not_retried. Gap: client-certificate and server-trust challenges and AcceptPolicy.onlyFromMainDocumentDomain are not done; verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: URL Loading: WebSocket and streaming tasks
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests (earlier part). Added later, host tests only: ws:// client task: send/receive text and binary, sendPing, cancel(with:reason:), auto-pong; plain TCP stream task with line and data reads. No wss:// or StartSecureConnection. Host tests only; verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: URL Loading: custom protocols and proxies, URL components
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 15 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. transport is swappable internally for tests only

publish/stop state, TXT records and a browser with didFind/didRemove delegate; the multicast transport feeds service_appeared/service_disappeared. No mDNS responder wired for advertise; verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/control.rs (JSON-RPC over owner-only Unix socket); docs/app-isolation.md
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. control socket serves RPC to an app with SO_PEERCRED check; no general app-to-service connection API or XPC services

features.feature: Object Runtime: exceptions, invocation, KVO, proxies
features.note: Objective-C runtime concepts; Rust has no counterpart. Observation covered by observable.rs

features.feature: Processes and Threads: queues and concurrency
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 29 tests. GCD-style DispatchQueue, group, work item, QoS and a main queue; no OperationQueue or RunLoop

features.feature: Processes and Threads: process information and activity
features.note: memory, cores, uptime, thermal state, low power mode, beginActivity, sudden termination

features.feature: Processes and Threads: launching child processes
features.note: Apps build a checked launch (absolute program, no NUL bytes, valid environment names), run it, and read the exit code or signal and both outputs (tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-rest-02.rs). Gap: the child is not confined by the shell's bubblewrap or cgroup policy, and pipes between processes are not exposed; the launch needs the lab machine to verify.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 15 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. std::net and std::io are usable directly; no stream or port abstractions with run-loop scheduling

features.feature: URL Loading: background sessions and download resume data
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. persisted task table per session identifier, Range/If-Range resume, 200 restarts from zero, didWriteData/didFinishDownloadingTo; host unit tests only, not wired into apps, no relaunch events; verify on Midget for parity.

gaps: Bonjour mDNS responder (advertise on the wire)
wss:// WebSocket and StartSecureConnection on stream tasks
Client-certificate and server-trust challenges. Digest answers cover MD5 with qop auth or none only (no MD5-sess, SHA-256 or auth-int) and keep no nonce count beyond the single retry.
Operation dependencies and quality-of-service classes for OperationQueue (sdk operation_queue.rs has the queue and its tests, operation_queue::tests, but no dependency graph or QoS).
